assets.label: seal support coolers
assets.service: barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at HX-4120

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on HX-4120 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. HX-4120 (seal support coolers) is in service for barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 5 August 2016 a potential incident was recorded on HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
